      public static double calculateLenskiGini(double capitalPerCapitaKg)
      Computes theoretical Lenski-Milanovic biophysical Gini coefficient directly from per-capita physical capital stock \(k_{\text{pc}} = K/N\) (\(\text{kg/capita}\)).

      capitalPerCapitaKg - per-capita physical capital stock \(k_{\text{pc}} = K/N\) in \(\text{kg/capita}\)
